title: FLA import: button symbol state frame labels (Up/Over/Down/Hit) not decoded from CPicPage timeline
description: Test added in packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/flash8-import.test.ts (describe block 'button symbol Up/Over/Down/Hit frame structure (task 0923)') using Magnet.fla fixture. Investigation finding: Flash binary FLA does NOT store textual 'Up'/'Over'/'Down'/'Hit' labels for button state frames — the state is positional by convention (frame 0=Up, 1=Over, 2=Down, 3=Hit). All button symbols in Magnet.fla (multiple: Symbol 10/11/13/34/35/78/WW2/Symbol 3/Play button) have exactly 4 frames with empty labels. Three tests verify: (1) all button symbols have exactly 4 frames in layer 0, (2) frame indices are 0-3, (3) labels survive import as '' and labelType='name'. No Buttons.fla fixture was needed; Magnet.fla (existing fixture) has abundant button symbols.
